picks.name: Roman Flügel & Zillas On Acid
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Sister Midnight. Minimal/tech-house territory connected to your Afriqua and Tiger Stripes picks.
picks.bio: "Conga Dream" (October 9, 2026, Sister Midnight) is a four-track collaboration between veteran German producer Roman Flügel and Zillas On Acid -- deep, percussive house and minimal techno built around looping conga rhythms.
picks.why_listen: A rhythmic, groove-forward collaboration from a dependable studio hand -- versatile house/techno crossover tools for a mid-set stretch.

picks.name: This & That
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Amancay. Buenos Aires house/techno territory.
picks.bio: "Devotion EP" (September 16, 2026, Amancay) is a solo three-track outing from Buenos Aires producer Facundo Ciaponi -- Devotion, Back To 85', and Drop It, blending afro house, indie dance and techno.
picks.why_listen: Warm, groove-centered house with an indie-dance edge -- flexible material from a South American scene worth tracking.
